title: Create example for Ubuntu Pro ESM
description:
Ubuntu sometimes releases security patches via an Ubuntu Pro subscription.

While we cannot build the container images enabling Ubuntu Pro, we should provide an example of how to do this with the images.

title: Add quarto and tinytex installation as an example
description:
Add quarto and tinytex installation as an example because this will be a commonly-needed layer added onto `-min` images.

Historically, we have handled the tinytex installation differently in different images:

- [content base](https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio-docker-products/blob/3a8395b54fa2c54a5597acb0f72fd3f7695c6d01/content/base/Dockerfile.ubuntu2204#L91) installs TinyTeX via  `curl -fsSL "https://yihui.org/tinytex/install-bin-unix.sh" | sh` which provides a minimal distribution missing commonly-used packages like fancyhdr.  
- connect, workbench, r-session-complete install TinyTeX via Quarto (`install_quarto.sh --install-tinytex --add-path-tinytex`) [ref](https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio-docker-products/blob/3a8395b54fa2c54a5597acb0f72fd3f7695c6d01/connect/Dockerfile.ubuntu2204#L19), which includes a fuller set of packages

We should follow the latter example where tinytex is installed via quarto.

title: Add pro drivers installation as an example
description: The `-min` images don't include the pro drivers, but are a commonly-needed part of production images.  Provide an example in `image-examples` for installing the pro drivers.
